text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for tenant 'prism' (dedicated-prod-prism-1). Alert: reserved-pool-95p-latency > 1200ms for 3m. Link: https://redwood.monitor/alerts/ALRT-9271 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PAGER ID PDR-9271 fired -> priority: urgent, escalation policy: ded-prod, routed to: alice@oncall.ack required.
alice: acked PDR-9271. I'm on it. Starting quick triage.
raj: seeing same on grafana — tail latency spike across all workers in prism-reserved-us-west-2. 95p at ~1.3s, errors 1.2% 503s.
marina: paging notes from logs: backend executor showing slow KV-cache hits; cache-miss ratio jumped ~4x at 14:02 UTC. Could be cache eviction churn after recent cron.
kevin: confirmed autoscaler didn't kick; reserved pool is at headroom 0. Two nodes in pool are at 98% GPU mem.
alice: running quick mitigation: enabling soft-throttle fallback to prg-quantized-variant for tenant prism to reduce memory usage.
alice: command run: ``rwictl rollout --tenant prism --model default-v1 --fallback prg-q4f --policy soft-fallback``
support-jamie: is this customer impacting production queries? Support tells Prism support channel that we're investigating.
marina: customer telemetry: 7% of requests are latency >1s and some client retries observed, affecting bulk ingest job for Prism. Recommend immediate temp capacity bump.
raj: trying scaling now: ``rwictl scale --pool prism-reserved-us-west-2 --add 2``
incident-bot: Scale request queued: job 6042. Expected new nodes ~4-6min.
kevin: while scale completes, let's reduce per-request batch size for prism routing to reduce KV pressure. Patch ready.
alice: applying routing config patch to lower max_batch_tokens to 512 for tenant prism (will reduce throughput but lower latency).
marina: note: rollback cron that ran 14:00 might have evicted cold KV entries; engineering on infra should follow up.
raj: new nodes coming up, health checks passing on 1 of 2 added nodes.
kevin: autoscaler bug: it didn't increment desired when headroom < 5% due to a rare float compare. Raising fix ticket but manual scale worked.
support-jamie: I posted a short status to prism-cs: "Investigating latency spike, temp mitigation applied, capacity being added, no full outage. We'll update in 15m."
alice: monitoring shows 95p latency dropping from 1.3s to ~750ms after fallback + one node. Errors down to 0.2%. Good signal.
marina: started collection of heap/kvcache stats and linking logs to wave-id: wave-9271-prism for postmortem.
kevin: I'm going to escalate to infra oncall for the autoscaler float-compare: @sre-oncall please pick up after we stabilize.
sre-oncall: acknowledged, will coordinate.
alice: handing off active incident at 15:06 UTC to raj for watch + follow-ups. I need to return to another page.
raj: taking over. I'll keep observing for 30m, coordinate with infra for root cause, and prepare a short incident note.
incident-bot: PAGER PDR-9271 auto-escalation suppressed; ack by alice.
alice: final for now — mitigation in place: fallback + +2 nodes + batch cap. Customer impact: partial latency increase for some requests and retries. No data loss. Next steps: infra to fix autoscaler logic, devops to investigate cron eviction, create postmortem.
support-jamie: follow-up task created: CS-4362 notify Prism CSM with summary and ETA for RCA.
raj: marking thread as active-watch. Will update with final timeline and link to postmortem doc when ready.
kevin: adding logs slice and span traces to incident ticket.
marina: thanks team. :thumbsup:
alice: thanks all, handing off closed for my shift.
